name: 600 bar-end shifter pair
weight_description: Manufacturer explicitly lists 160 g per left/right SL-BC10 bar-end control pair, with spiral balance springs. This is a directly published pair figure, not one control doubled.

sources.title: Shimano Bicycle System Components, 1982, PDF page 69 / printed page 66: SL-BC10 identity, configuration and listed specifications
